name: r/LocalLLM on Reddit: Pi coding agent is amazing (or how I learned to stop worrying and leave OpenCode)
description: It's basically, "Hey, you're an agent now, you have these basic tools, go for it." So Pi is almost completely dependent on the model knowing how to be a coding agent. But it turns out Qwen3.6 already knows this.
